independent_checks.test: CROSSOVER independent small AB BA treatment period and sequence quantities
independent_checks.derivation: Half-period values AB=(2,3), BA=(-4,-3), each variance .5; treatment=6, pooled SD=SE=sqrt(.5), df=2, t=6*sqrt(2). Half-treatment values AB=(2,3), BA=(4,3); period=-1, t=-sqrt(2). Sequence differences have means5/7; cell means14/9/9/16; folded F=1, p=1 by symmetry.
independent_checks.tolerances: Counts, means and integer DF exact. Absolute1e-14 for SD/SE, period t and Welch DF;1e-13 for treatment t and F probability to cover f64 rounding at these small magnitudes.

independent_checks.test: CROSSOVER response-pair missingness and FREQ preserve replicated counts
independent_checks.derivation: FREQ2.9 truncates to2, giving AB half-differences(2,2,3), BA(-4,-3), n=3/2, residual df=3, treatment=35/6. Explicit physical replication preserves SE and period p. Missing either response, FREQ<1 and nonpositive weight are excluded.
independent_checks.tolerances: Counts/DF exact;1e-14 absolute for rational estimate and physical-replication identities.

independent_checks.test: CROSSOVER independent small AB BA treatment period and sequence quantities
independent_checks.derivation: Relabel treatments: treatment sign reverses, period stays. Reverse periods and sequences: treatment stays, period sign reverses.
independent_checks.tolerances: Exact equality for these integer/half-integer contrast identities.
